listSubtitle: Open ones first, then closed — newest on top
listEmpty: No work orders yet. Open a truck's page and press “Open work order”.
notFoundTitle: This work order does not exist
notFoundBody: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list of work orders.
closedNote: This work order is closed. To add or change work, press “Reopen” above.
odoRequired: Type the odometer reading in digits.
editOdoHint: The next maintenance dates are counted from this number. Correct it if it was mistyped.
closeBody: Once closed, no more work can be added to this order. You can reopen it at any time.
closeUndoneWarn: Tasks not marked done: {{n}}. They will not count toward the maintenance dates.
closeEmptyWarn: This order is empty. If it was opened by mistake, delete it instead of closing it.
deleteBody: This is for an order opened by mistake (wrong truck, or opened twice). The order is removed together with its odometer reading and its tasks. Tasks: {{n}}. This cannot be undone.
deleteRefusedNote: If the order has an oil change or tire work the app will refuse to delete it — remove that work first.
deleteBlockedTitle: This order cannot be deleted yet
deleteBlockedBody: It holds work that took from stock or moved a tire. Remove that work first, then delete the order:
deleteBlockedOil: Oil change: delete it in the “Oil change” section of this screen.
deleteBlockedTires: Tire work: undo it from the “tire diagram”.
notesEmpty: No notes. Write the driver's complaint here, or anything still waiting.
tasksHint: Mark each task “Done” when it is finished. A task that is not marked does not count toward the maintenance dates.
tasksEmpty: No tasks on this order yet.
addTaskCategoryHint: This task is linked to a maintenance type: marking it done restarts that maintenance's schedule.
taskClockHint: Marking it done restarts the schedule for “{{name}}”.
editTaskCategoryWarn: This task is marked done. Changing its type changes the maintenance dates: the old type goes back to its previous date and the new type is counted from here.
deleteTaskBody: The task is removed from the work order.
deleteTaskBodyDone: This task is marked done. If you delete it, its maintenance date goes back to what it was before.
oilEmpty: No oil change on this order.
oilNotInStock: This type is not in stock right now. You can still record it.
oilNewTypeHint: This is a new oil type — it is added to the list by itself once you record it.
oilStockShort: This is more than what is in stock. You can still record it, but check the stock.
oilBandWarn: The usual amount is {{min}} to {{max}} L. Check the number — if it is right, record it.
oilEditHint: If you change the amount or the type, stock is adjusted by the difference.
oilDeleteBody: The liters go back to stock ({{liters}}), and the oil-change date goes back to what it was.
oilDeleted: Oil change deleted; the liters are back in stock
tireEmpty: No tire work on this order.
openExistsTitle: This truck already has an open work order
openExistsBody: Opened {{date}}. Carry on with it instead of opening a new one.
openExistsGo: Go to the open work order
openOdoLower: This is lower than the truck's last reading ({{km}}). Check the number.
openOdoJump: This is more than {{diff}} km above the last reading ({{km}}). Check the number.
openOdoConfirm: I checked — the number is right
openOdoConfirmed: Open the work order with this number
